name: Aries Brattenhardt
original_name: アリエス・ブラッテンハルト
source:
Princess of the Kingdom of Brattenhardt. She has a noble and dignified appearance and excels in both literary and military arts.She is passionate about her country and patriotism, and she believes that she must “protect her beloved people.

Although she is royalty, as a princess knight, she has been involved in a wide range of activities, such as maintaining domestic security, fighting in war zones, and providing relief to disaster-stricken areas, and has achieved numerous feats of valor.

She has been devoted to rigorous daily training in swordsmanship to strengthen her body and mind, so she has excellent proportions, with feminine features and toned parts. 

Naturally, she has received offers of marriage from other countries because of her appearance, but she continues to decline.
Love to her is not her main priority.

She believes that her lover is in this country, until she meets the man of her dreams who she considers to be more desirable than she is.

She has known Princesses Charlene and Mireia, with whom she has formed an alliance, since childhood and knows them well. They are also dear friends and have grown up together like sisters. She is the eldest of the three.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/sanbiki.html#character]official site[/url]]
